admission.justification: Binds drift and observer reads to file-only operation: a read never grows scope, registry, checklist or snapshot output on its own.

alternatives.option: Drift reads the file and returns its summary; Markdown report and observer snapshot exist only behind an explicit output.write_report caller.
alternatives.reason: Read-only content must not re-grow the artifacts it inspects; surprise writes turn every read into a producer.

alternatives.option: File a temp Markdown report on every drift read.
alternatives.reason: Turns every read into a producer and re-grows the artifacts the read inspects.
alternatives.reconsider_when: An explicit report-producing caller is absent and readers need file-backed reports by default.

consequences: Future read paths keep write_report-gating and never attach a default report side effect to a summary value.
context: MIK-R74 rule-6 read hygiene: DriftSummaryOutput(write_report=False); memory_tools and the onboarding drift summary state the same boundary.
